title: Exemplar applications: calendar, music player, clock, file manager

scope.objective: Four complete exemplar GUI applications authored in GY-LANG/1 scene syntax with thin deterministic host state machines, each with headless acceptance tests and live Wayland presentation.
exclusions: real audio playback of tracks (tones only)

implementation_record.notes: Each app follows the calculator exemplar contract. Notable glyph-set constraint handling: calendar uses '-'/'+/today' labels, clock uses '.' separators and 'clear' (glyph set excludes uppercase and several letters), file manager names files within the renderable alphabet.

results.headless: all four ALL CHECKS PASS exit 0
results.live: calendar/clock/music/files windows presented (clock ticked to real time display in live run)
results.uni: 73/100 exit 1 — advisory-only regression: large single-file app hunks (ferret), /proc/cpuinfo platform constant + test-side assert patterns (traci/edwardian). No behavioural findings; CI cargo gates green. Structural splitting (multi-file apps) is the recorded remedy, deferred as churn vs. value.
integration_fixes: calendar test premise: Nov has 30 days not 31
